summary:
Introduction to the Program

Health Psychology and the Development of Preventive Programs for Adolescents and Youth

A basic theoretical-methodological and applied video course for specialists of state and municipal organizations, educational psychologists, and organizers of preventive work.

🎯

Module 1. Fundamentals of Health Psychology

Concepts of health and illness, George Engel's biopsychosocial model, mechanisms of stress and resilience, the phenomenon of deviance, and key prevention models.

🔬

Module 2. Research in the Prevention System

Methodology of the evidence-based approach: qualitative and quantitative methods, interviews, structured observation, quasi-experiments, population surveys, and screening psychodiagnostics.

📊

Module 3. Design and Evidence-Based Evaluation

Actuarial risk and opportunity assessment (ROA), design of preventive interventions (RCT / Cohort), project logical framework matrix, calendar planning, and effectiveness measurement.

💡
Main goal of the course: To overcome intuitive and punitive approaches in prevention, equipping specialists with practical tools for early prevention based on protective factors and evidence-based models.
